_comment: Wording lab: candidate wordings for the Location node (docs/ROADMAP.md, F1),
rendered side by side by tools/wortlabor.py. Nothing here is a preset yet: a
wording moves into PRESETS (nodes/location_builder.py) only after the user's
verdict on the sheets; the smoke test holds PRESETS to the tested wordings.
Every candidate goes into the scene slot, the way the Location node's set
reaches Build Prompt; the light slot stays empty so no light setup competes
with the place, and the example's person, style and template stay as they
are (tools/baue_workflow.py). bildausschnitt is the Series framing: full body
for the places, so the set is in frame, and kamera_mit_ausschnitt puts the
Series' own wording for it into the camera slot. Groups A-D are the four
families (studio, urban, nature, interior): four places each, two
candidates against the bare word (kontrolle). D starts with the loft, the
one place already in PRESETS, as the reference row (referenz).
E-G are time of day, weather and season, split so each sheet stays
readable: each candidate is composed with a place by the node's own
compose_location() (zusatz; 'texte' puts another candidate's wording into
a field), outdoors on gasse-a, the seasons on wald-a; two time-of-day rows
sit on the loft, since time of day applies indoors too. Weather and season
are outdoor fields (NUR_DRAUSSEN) and are tested outdoors only.
H tests the Series' short form for close framings (location_builder.
kurzform(): the first clause of each part) at portrait framing: the full
set as control against its short form.
